n6afa2a79e5.headline: RBM loosens grip on diplomats
n6afa2a79e5.summary: The Reserve Bank of Malawi has allowed foreign missions and international NGOs to quote staff remuneration in foreign currency. The approval follows a request from the international community for access to their money in foreign currency.
n6afa2a79e5.why: The central bank manages Malawi's currency and foreign exchange rules, which govern how foreign-funded organisations pay their staff.

nfdb25d3c2c.headline: BREAKING: Dangote Refinery crashes ex-depot petrol price to N890
nfdb25d3c2c.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery has cut the ex-depot price of petrol from N950 to N890, effective Saturday. The company cites favourable developments in the global energy sector and a significant decline in international prices.
nfdb25d3c2c.why: Dangote Refinery is a large Nigerian refiner whose ex-depot pump prices influence fuel costs across West Africa.

ndd1797cd94.headline: Agriculture and sustainable mobility, from the European investment bank (beautiful) 100 million to Calabria
ndd1797cd94.summary: The European Investment Bank is providing €100 million to Calabria for youth employment, modern infrastructure and the ecological transition. Funding covers sustainable agriculture, clean mobility and water efficiency.
ndd1797cd94.why: The European Investment Bank is the EU's lending arm, and its regional loans finance infrastructure and climate projects.

n038d933bd7.headline: Barclays customers ‘still unable to make payments’ as mass bank outage continues
n038d933bd7.summary: Barclays customers said they were still unable to make payments as a mass outage continued, and the bank apologised for intermittent errors in its payment system.
n038d933bd7.why: Barclays is a major UK bank, and prolonged outages raise operational-risk and regulatory questions for lenders.

na413ccbdd4.headline: Trump imposes new tariffs on imports from Mexico, Canada and China in new phase of trade war
na413ccbdd4.summary: Starting Tuesday, nearly all imports from Canada and Mexico will face a 25% tariff, while goods from China will face a 10% tariff. The move marks a new phase of the US trade war.
na413ccbdd4.why: Tariffs raise the cost of imported goods and can disrupt supply chains across North American and Asian manufacturing. Investors track them closely because they shift trade flows, inflation expectations and corporate margins.

n542694ac4f.headline: India to provide $647 million to support strategic reserve oil purchases in 2025-26
n542694ac4f.summary: India will provide 55.97 billion rupees, about $647 million, to support oil purchases for its strategic petroleum reserves in 2025-26, the budget document showed on Saturday.
n542694ac4f.why: Strategic petroleum reserves are government stockpiles that cushion supply disruptions. India is a major oil importer, so its reserve policy affects global crude demand.

nfc40988920.headline: Govt raises limit for TDS on interest income for senior citizens to Rs 1 lakh - OrissaPOST
nfc40988920.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman proposed doubling the TDS limit on interest income for senior citizens to Rs 1 lakh. The rent threshold would rise to Rs 6 lakh in the Budget speech.
nfc40988920.why: Tax deducted at source changes affect household income, bank deposit flows and the fiscal policy the Indian government sets through its annual Budget.

nbf96af85d2.headline: Alcohol price rises come into effect on Saturday - how much more you will pay
nbf96af85d2.summary: Alcohol price rises came into effect on Saturday in the UK. One industry expert warned consumers to brace to pay substantially more for their favourite products.
nbf96af85d2.why: Changes to alcohol duty affect pub and retail pricing, producers and the consumer price basket.

nf3a43d8362.headline: Trump will hit Mexico, Canada and China with tariffs
nf3a43d8362.summary: US President Donald Trump announced tariffs on imports from Mexico, Canada and China. The report does not give rates or effective dates.
nf3a43d8362.why: Tariffs raise the cost of imported goods and can disrupt supply chains for North American and Asian trade. They are watched closely by investors in exporters and currencies.
nf3a43d8362.why_moved: The announced tariffs on three major trading partners raise concerns about trade costs and retaliation.

n2fa5a3d354.headline: Corporate winners and losers from India's budget
n2fa5a3d354.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman unveiled the annual budget on Saturday, focused on boosting the spending power of the middle class and encouraging inclusive development. The article assesses which companies gain or lose from the measures.
n2fa5a3d354.why: India's annual budget sets tax and spending policy that can reshape earnings expectations across sectors, and it is a key event for Indian equity investors.

ne329d189bd.headline: ZEEKR Announces January 2025 Delivery Update
ne329d189bd.summary: Zeekr Intelligent Technology, a premium electric vehicle company based in Hangzhou, announced its January 2025 delivery results.
ne329d189bd.why: Zeekr is a Chinese premium electric vehicle maker, and monthly delivery volumes are a key indicator of its sales momentum.

ne4938ec89b.headline: Takeaways from India's budget that slashes income tax on the salaried middle class to spur growth
ne4938ec89b.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government presented an annual budget cutting income tax for the salaried middle class. It also aims to boost agriculture and manufacturing to spur growth.
ne4938ec89b.why: India's annual budget sets tax and spending policy for the world's fast-growing large economies, shaping consumer demand, fiscal deficits and investor sentiment.
ne4938ec89b.why_moved: The budget cuts income tax on salaried workers and focuses on agriculture and manufacturing to spur growth. Tax relief for consumers and growth measures can shift expectations for Indian equities.

n86425cc3d4.headline: How India's tax rate tweaks will boost middle class spending
n86425cc3d4.summary: The Indian government announced the biggest tax relief in at least a decade on Saturday. The measure is intended to boost consumer demand and revive growth in the fifth-largest economy.
n86425cc3d4.why: India is the world's fifth-largest economy, and tax changes affecting middle-class incomes influence consumer spending, corporate earnings and domestic equity markets.

n3e47061ebb.headline: Indian real estate firms cheer government's tax relief plan to boost consumption
n3e47061ebb.summary: Shares of Indian real estate companies rose on Saturday after the government announced measures to boost middle-class spending power. The move is likely to spur consumption in Asia's third-biggest economy.
n3e47061ebb.why: Real estate developers in India depend heavily on domestic household demand and mortgage affordability, so consumer tax relief can feed directly into housing sales.
n3e47061ebb.why_moved: Investors expect the government's tax relief for the middle class to boost consumption and housing demand, lifting real estate shares.

n8652bb065f.headline: India's tax relief may not be enough to boost economic growth, Moody's says
n8652bb065f.summary: Moody's Ratings said India's decision to ease the tax burden on middle-class consumers may not have a large impact on growth. The comment followed the federal budget.
n8652bb065f.why: Moody's is a major credit rating agency whose views influence investor assessments of sovereign risk and growth prospects. Tax policy changes affect household spending and government revenue.

n50f742a112.headline: Probe into whether DeepSeek used restricted US AI chips
n50f742a112.summary: The US is reportedly investigating whether Chinese company DeepSeek used restricted chips to build its AI model.
n50f742a112.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI developer, and export controls on advanced US chips shape the cost and availability of AI computing worldwide.

ne6f25d63a4.headline: Snap election doesn't leave Ontario vulnerable amid trade war, Doug Ford insists
ne6f25d63a4.summary: Progressive Conservative Leader Doug Ford called a snap election as a trade war with the United States escalates. He insists Ontario is not vulnerable during the campaign.
ne6f25d63a4.why: Ontario is Canada's most populous province and a major manufacturing and auto hub, so its politics and trade exposure matter for Canadian growth.

n5740882497.headline: Trump Meets Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at White House to Discuss China's DeepSeek, Tightening Chip Exports
n5740882497.summary: President Donald Trump and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly met at the White House to discuss China's DeepSeek AI technology. They also discussed tightening chip exports.
n5740882497.why: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI accelerator chips, and US export rules on advanced chips shape its sales to China.
n5740882497.why_moved: Reported discussions on tightening chip exports to China raise the risk of restrictions on Nvidia's China sales.

n490d79ac92.headline: Mali's Resource Nationalism: The Barrick Gold Standoff | Headlines
n490d79ac92.summary: Mali is demanding $200 million in back taxes from Barrick Gold, amid claims of money laundering. The dispute highlights resource nationalism in military-led West African states.
n490d79ac92.why: Barrick Gold is one of the world's largest gold miners, so tax disputes and resource-policy changes in host countries can affect its output and valuation.

n6f7a2d9bcc.headline: Citicore executes share block sale for Indonesian firm entry
n6f7a2d9bcc.summary: Citicore Power completed a block sale of 153.74 million common shares in Citicore Renewable Energy, paving the way for Indonesian power firm Pertamina to enter the company.
n6f7a2d9bcc.why: Block sales transfer large stakes between investors, and Pertamina is Indonesia's state-owned energy company, so its entry signals a cross-border energy partnership.

nf6507888a5.headline: MSMEs to absorb impact of proposed P200 minimum wage hike – DOLE
nf6507888a5.summary: Micro, small and medium enterprises should be taken into consideration before any decision on the proposed PHP200 daily wage increase, according to the labor department. MSMEs are expected to absorb the impact.
nf6507888a5.why: Minimum wage changes in the Philippines affect labor costs across the economy, especially for small firms that make up most businesses. Wage policy influences inflation and corporate margins.

nb55894899d.headline: ‘Rate cuts have limited impact on credit growth’
nb55894899d.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Research Academy says rate hikes tighten credit, but lowering rates does not necessarily boost lending. The analysis points to limited credit effects from cuts.
nb55894899d.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippine central bank, and its policy rate influences borrowing costs, lending and inflation. Credit growth is a key indicator of domestic demand.

ncdbff57fbb.headline: Key questions ahead of Trump's tariffs on Canadian goods
ncdbff57fbb.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is set to hit Canadian goods with 25 per cent tariffs on Tuesday, with a lower 10 per cent duty for energy, according to provincial government sources.
ncdbff57fbb.why: Canada is a major exporter of energy, autos and metals to the United States, so tariffs on its goods affect supply chains and corporate margins on both sides of the border.
ncdbff57fbb.why_moved: Planned US tariffs of 25% on Canadian goods, with a 10% rate on energy, raise trade costs for exporters, particularly in sectors reliant on cross-border supply.

n4bad049e8d.headline: The $239b Aussie industry smashing investment records
n4bad049e8d.summary: Australia’s exchange-traded funds industry continues to grow, with assets surpassing $239 billion, reflecting strong investor interest.
n4bad049e8d.why: The size and growth of ETF assets indicate investor confidence and market liquidity in Australia.

ndc888df43b.headline: NRC Insists Narrow-Gauge Rail Lines Are Operational Amid Workers' Concerns
ndc888df43b.summary: NRC has refuted reports suggesting its narrow-gauge rail lines are dormant, insisting they remain operational.
ndc888df43b.why: Rail infrastructure impacts freight and passenger transport, influencing trade and logistics sectors in Nigeria.

n883b33fcf4.headline: Chinese-Style Modernization: Revolution and the Worker-Peasant Alliance
n883b33fcf4.summary: China's successful navigation of urban-rural relations is key to its economic development and modernization efforts.
n883b33fcf4.why: China's economic strategy impacts global supply chains and investment flows, especially in manufacturing and agriculture sectors.

n60a929b97a.headline: Budget FY26 has made agriculture the engine of rural prosperity and resilience
n60a929b97a.summary: The FY26 budget increases subsidized farm loans from Rs 3 lakh to Rs 5 lakh and focuses on credit access, crop insurance, and agri-value chains to enhance rural prosperity.
n60a929b97a.why: Agriculture is a key sector for India's rural economy and financial inclusion, with budget reforms impacting farmer incomes and rural demand.

nc84cb2fe7b.headline: Budget 2025 Highlights: Taxpayer with annual income of Rs 12 lakh to get benefit of Rs 80,000, says Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman
nc84cb2fe7b.summary: India’s 2025 budget outlines tax slabs with benefits for taxpayers earning up to Rs 12 lakh annually, including a maximum benefit of Rs 80,000.
nc84cb2fe7b.why: Tax policy changes impact consumer spending, investment, and government revenues, influencing India’s economic growth and market sentiment.
